description: Defines provider enums, mappings, and helper functions for provider logos, placeholders, and model filtering in a machine learning UI project.

methods.name: getProviderLogoAndName
methods.description: Returns the logo URL and display name for a given provider value.

methods.name: getPlaceholder
methods.description: Provides a placeholder string based on the selected provider.

methods.name: getProviderModels
methods.description: Filters and returns models associated with a specific provider from a model map.
